name: MultiRC
description: Multi-Sentence Reading Comprehension (MultiRC) is a reading comprehension benchmark where each question may have multiple correct answers. Models answer yes/no for each candidate answer across diverse paragraph sources. The key challenge is that questions often require multi-sentence reasoning across the passage.
evaluation_method: F1 (exact match over all answer options)
reputation: Component benchmark of SuperGLUE; evaluates multi-sentence reasoning with multiple correct answers; sourced from diverse passage types
notes: Introduced at NAACL 2018. Passages from 7 domains: news, fiction, historical texts, etc. Each question has 2-5 candidate answers, each labeled true/false. Included as a task in SuperGLUE benchmark. Requires cross-sentence reasoning to identify all correct answers. Performance metrics measure ability to correctly classify all candidates.
